review.notes: Two passes by this reviewer against the pinned baseline (mathlib 082e2d3, tauceti f790474); the second pass re-verified every first-pass correction instead of trusting it. Scope as submitted: 5 roadmaps, 46 layers (all present, none extra), 206 targets, 146 citations of 110 distinct declarations, 80 duplicate claims. Mechanical: every citation resolves at its library, file and line with the right namespace; none is private, an axiom or a bare structure field; no cited file contains sorry or admit. Two names did not resolve: HarmonicAt is InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt, and Algebra.IsCentralSimple occurs only in a docstring (Mathlib uses Algebra.IsCentral with IsSimpleRing). After correction there are 185 citations of 145 distinct declarations, all re-validated the same way. Presence: all 55 targets claiming something present (5 mathlib and 50 partial as submitted) were re-derived from the source, with variable lines and hypotheses read. One was wrong: QM.1's theta target was marked mathlib, but Mathlib has only the S- and T^2-laws and neither library has a theta multiplier system, a half-integral-weight automorphy factor or a Jacobi form; it is partial, and QM.1 is not built. Absence: all 151 absent targets were rechecked, 116 by fresh concept, naming-convention and grep searches of both trees and declarations.tsv, and 35 conditional or export targets against their prerequisites. None is present. The searches found material the notes denied or omitted, now cited: Mathlib's pentagonal number theorem (in R[[X]] and for |x| < 1) and its general multipliability theorem for power-series products; the quasimodular law of E2; Tau Ceti's real error function; the Fredholm alternative over any complete nontrivially normed field, Tau Ceti's finite-dimensional generalized eigenspaces of compact operators, and Matrix.charpolyRev as the finite-rank characteristic power series; Tau Ceti's classical U_p (HeckeRing.GL2.heckeUNat) and level-raising operator; Lagrangian subspaces of a real symplectic space; Sp_2m and affine group schemes over any commutative algebra, hence adelic points as abstract groups; projective representations and their linearization over a central extension; continuous characters of Z_p; relative normalization of schemes, regular local rings and Zariski-local representability; totally positive units; local coefficient systems; faithfully flat descent for modules. Notes that misdescribed the libraries were corrected, among them a false claim that Mathlib has Galois descent for quasi-coherent sheaves, a claim that no U_p exists, claims that there are no Lagrangian polarizations and no adelic points, and a claim that no p-adic compact-operator theory exists. Duplicates: a claim stands when the named layer itself states one of the layer's targets, or a special case or generalization of one; a layer that only supplies an input or consumes an output is not a duplicate. On that rule 14 of the 80 submitted claims were removed: L5 to L0a (same roadmap), H6 to R23.1 (Moret-Bailly), O0 to L2a (co-consumer), R18.1 to D5 (no quaternionic datum), QM.6 to R12.3, L4 to R04.1, QM.2 to ES.3 (the Hardy-Ramanujan-Rademacher route uses no singular integrals or local densities), QM.5 to HB.10, L2a to AG2.3 (which calls itself not a duplicate eigenvariety engine), MP.7 and MP.8 to BSD.2 (explicitly disjoint steps), R18.4 to R34.5 and R15.1, and R18.6 to S5. One was replaced (O7: IG.2 by HodgeTateAndCanonicalSubgroups T5), one note was corrected (PadicFamilies L1 to ModularSymbolsPadicLFunctions L2), and 25 were added, including ShimuraData D0 and ReductiveGroupsPartII RG2.0a for H0, AbelianSchemesAndArithmeticModuli A2 and A3 for H1 and H4, AdicSpacesPartII R2 for H2, AF.5 and R17.3 for R18.3-R18.4, R19.6, PG.7 and AutomorphicCongruences L3 for PadicFamilies L4, ModularSymbolsPadicLFunctions L2 (p-stabilizations) for L0, PerfectoidSpaces P9 for O1, Tau Ceti's ModularForms layer 8 (modular symbols, Eichler integrals; not built) for PadicFamilies L1 and QM.5, and the built Tau Ceti Monster presentation for QM.6. All 91 remaining claims resolve to live, visible atlas stages; none is retired. Verdicts after correction: 43 not built, 2 partly built (QM.0, PadicFamilies L0a) and 1 process (R18.6), each consistent with its targets. Four roadmap summaries were rewritten or updated.
